intro: Mongolia has about 3.5 million people, nearly half of them in Ulaanbaatar.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are Khalkha Mongols; Kazakhs live in the far west. Mongolian is written in Cyrillic, and the old vertical script is being revived. Tibetan Buddhism is the main religion.
About a quarter of people still herd sheep, goats, horses, yaks and camels.

chapters.title: More animals than people
text: Mongolia has around 70 million livestock, about 20 for every person.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who looks after grazing animals.
